channel.description: Notes on organic optoelectronics, through-space charge transfer and computational workflow.

item.title: How far apart are the decks?
item.description: What deck separation in a paracyclophane really means. Why [2.2] has no single value. What to state before comparing two numbers.

item.title: Reading a hole-electron analysis
item.description: A HOMO to LUMO label says little about charge transfer. Here is a practical Gaussian to Multiwfn workflow. It explains what the Sr, D and t indices measure.

item.title: Charge transfer without a bridge
item.description: Why stacking a donor on an acceptor shrinks the singlet-triplet gap. What paracyclophane does that a twisted biaryl cannot. Where the useful window of distance sits.
